title: Staff Software Engineer - Frontend
description:

  • Experiência com ferramentas CSS-in-JS (ex: styled-components, Emotion, etc.);

Se você se identifica com esse desafio e quer construir soluções de escala com propósito, vem com a gente!

title: Senior Estimator
description:
Company Overview:

Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.


For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.


Job Overview:

The Senior Estimator uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the estimating discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the estimating discipline. The Senior Estimator solves complex problems and uses their discipline-specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Estimator impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the estimating team and other related teams and ensures that they are working within the appropriate guidelines and policies.


Job Responsibility:

  • Review, query, and understand the scope of work in order to prepare a proper estimate and direct attention to those areas that appear inconsistent or contain a high-risk element .
  • Support the PMT team to generate the Marine/Offshore Estimate for the Preliminary stage to ensure Bid No Bid.
  • Review the Project Plan along with the project planner and prepare subcontract scope packages for any work that is required to be subcontracted.
  • Gather information and input from functions with support from the Project Manager.
  • Consult with Subject Matter Expert (SME) to discuss Estimates and resolve issues.
  • Generate estimates with available Benchmark data and from experience prior to receiving the inputs from functions and evaluate the estimates received from functions against the internal estimate
  • Liaise with Project Team members plus all functional departments based on the specific functions allotted for a project, subcontractors and vendors, and Customer; including Procurement, Fabrication, Marine, Quality, HSES, Completions, and Welding Technology
  • Provide input to the Project Estimators, along with Basis of Estimate and Bench Markers
  • Give regular updates to the department manager/PMT /immediate supervisor and highlight any concerns about anything that might potentially jeopardize submitting a competitive proposal.
  • Analyze the cost components that are critical/crucial and seek quotes for applicable items.
  • Participate in Bid review meetings, estimate evaluation meetings, Risk assessment meetings, as well as any additional bid-related meetings, as required.
  • Prepare a comprehensive Basis of Estimate (BOE).
  • Review and identify contract price form.
  • Understand and clarify unit rate and lump sum breakdowns.
  • Accurately manage all the Previous Tender information and Treat it with Confidentiality
  • Utilize support from the benchmarking team (SMEs) by analyzing information on the costs from other similar projects and preparing the relevant benchmark report.
  • Attend and participate in Bid review meetings, estimate evaluation meetings, Risk assessment meetings, etc., as necessary for the Project/Department/Tender
  • Participate in HAZAN, HAZID, HAZOP, and other safety /operability/ reliability studies and workshops, as necessary for Project/Tender
  • Ensure any Risk or Opportunity highlighted is Duly captured for the Management review and approval.
  • Post Tender submission provide input for the clarification.
  • Support bid handover process ensuring proper transfer of pricing basis and critical assumptions to project team.
  • Manage own time to meet objectives; forecast and plan resource requirements.
  • Incorporate project planner input to develop the cost.
  • Assure that the estimate is:
  • Completed promptly
  • Cognizant of the Bid ‘Win Strategy’
  • Aligned with planned schedeule
  • All the Risk and Opportunities highlighted.
  • With Due Basis of Estimate
  • Accurate, free of errors, omission, or hidden contingency
  • In line with the agreed execution plan
  • Evaluate and recommend ways to be more cost-effective or profitable


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or related technical discipline preferred. Equivalent experience will be considered.
  • Five plus (5+) years of experience in a large Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) company (preferably in Offshore/Marine Operations, and offshore estimation, ).
  • Subsea/SURF experience with Minimum 3–5 years of direct experience in subsea/SURF construction estimation, including deepwater pipeline installation, flexible/umbilical lay, subsea structure installation, and marine spread costs.
  • Experience with DSV, PLSV, and/or Heavy Construction Vessel (HCV) spread rate estimation strongly preferred.
  • Cost estimation experience, preferably in the Oil & Gas industry
  • Willingness to work overtime as necessary to meet deadlines
  • Intermediate level in Microsoft Office systems, e.g., Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Project
  • Accurately evaluate detailed specifications that are crucial to a cost estimator’s success
  • Must pay attention to minute details because such details may impact a product’s overall cost

Must plan their work and work efficiently and accurately.

title: Business Development Specialist
description:
Description


Take your career to the next level as Business Developer Specialist , playing a key role in driving business growth, strengthening client relationships, and leading high-performing teams in Rio de Janeiro .

In this role, you will be responsible for expanding existing accounts, developing new business opportunities, and ensuring excellent delivery and client satisfaction. You will act as a strategic partner for clients while also managing and mentoring a team, contributing to the sustainable growth of the business.

You will work closely with international teams across sales, delivery, and talent management to position the company as a trusted partner for companies seeking specialized expertise.


Your responsibilities


Business Development & Growth

  • Identify and develop new business opportunities within existing and new clients
  • Contribute to defining and executing the growth strategy in Brazil
  • Support sales activities including prospecting, client meetings, and proposal building


Account Development & Client Management

  • Manage and grow a portfolio of strategic client accounts
  • Build long-term relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers
  • Ensure high levels of client satisfaction and identify upselling opportunities


Team Management

  • Lead, coach, and support a team of consultants and/or business developers
  • Follow up on team performance, engagement, and career development
  • Foster a collaborative and high-performance team environment


Operational Excellence & Delivery

  • Ensure successful project delivery in collaboration with internal teams
  • Act as the main point of contact between clients and delivery teams
  • Monitor performance indicators and drive continuous improvement


Profile required


  • 3 to 4 years of experience in business development, account management, or consulting
  • Experience managing client relationships and developing business within accounts
  • Previous experience in team management or coordination
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (mandatory)
  • Spanish is a plus
  • Availability to work fully on-site in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil


What we offer

  • A dynamic and international work environment
  • Career growth opportunities in a fast-scaling organization
  • Exposure to strategic clients and high-impact projects
  • Competitive compensation package


We are committed to promoting diversity and inclusion within our teams. All qualified applications are considered regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or other characteristics.

title: Business Analyst
description:
The Business Analyst will work closely with the Product Owner on a daily basis, supporting the structuring, detailing, and communication of requirements and serving as an extension of the PO within the squad. This professional will help translate business needs into clear, actionable backlog items and ensure alignment between stakeholders and the delivery team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the right hand of the Product Owner, providing continuous support in backlog management and requirement definition.
  • Support the PO in the creation, refinement, and maintenance of Epics, User Stories, Tasks, and Acceptance Criteria, ensuring clarity and business value.
  • Prepare and support backlog refinement sessions, ensuring stories are well‑defined, estimated, prioritized, and ready for development.
  • Serve as a key point of support for the squad to clarify requirements, scope, and dependencies on behalf of the PO.
  • Manage and maintain artifacts using JIRA (backlog, stories, tasks, progress tracking) and Confluence (documentation, specifications, and decisions).
  • Support Agile ceremonies such as Sprint Planning, Daily Scrums, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
  • Lead Agile ceremonies when necessary, especially in the PO’s absence or when additional facilitation is required.
  • Ensure alignment between business expectations and the squad’s delivery capabilities.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience as a Business Analyst supporting Product Owners in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Strong expertise in writing and refining Epics, User Stories, Tasks, and Acceptance Criteria.
  • Hands‑on experience with JIRA and Confluence.
  • Solid understanding of Agile principles and frameworks (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Strong facilitation, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills.
  • Ability to act autonomously as PO support while maintaining close alignment with the Product Owner.
  • Detail‑oriented, proactive, and delivery‑focused mindset.

Nice to Have

  • Experience acting as a proxy or delegate for the Product Owner.
  • Experience supporting cross‑functional or distributed Agile teams.

title: Supervisor de Enfermagem - UTI Cardio Intensiva - Hospital Niterói D'Or

title: Desenvolvedor C# Sênior
description:

  • Experiência com SignalR para comunicação real-time.

  • Vivência com CloudFormation ou Terraform para IaC.
  • Conhecimento em processamento de documentos (PDF, Excel, OCR).

Benefícios

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises looking to deploy advanced AI systems. We are looking for an experienced Technical Matcher (recruiter) to manage the end-to-end recruitment delivery for customer-side non-technical and technical roles at Turing.   • Ensure data accuracy and visibility across systems — maintaining reports on hiring pipelines, fulfillment progress, and performance metrics.
  • Track and report fulfillment metrics, including fill rates, turnaround times, and candidate quality.
  • Partner with recruiting and sourcing teams to improve process efficiency and hiring velocity.
  • Deliver a strong stakeholder experience, maintaining proactive communication and alignment on timelines and expectations.


Qualifications & Experience

  • Working knowledge of LinkedIn Recruiter (good to have) and Google tools (Sheets, Docs, Drive) for tracking and reporting.

  • Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills.

Nice to Have

title: Senior Ruby on Rails Engineer
description:
About StayFi

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 8 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love.


About You
  • You're a senior full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 7+ years of professional experience building and shipping production applications.
  • You're a product-minded engineer who takes ownership. You think beyond each task / ticket and consider the broader impact of your technical decisions on the business.
  • You write expressive, readable, and maintainable code and hold yourself and others to a high standard through thoughtful code reviews.
  • You have a strong command of Rails conventions but know when and how to diverge from them pragmatically.
  • You're comfortable navigating and improving legacy codebases, not just greenfield projects.
  • You're curious about IoT, WiFi, and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.

  • You're energized by working on a small team where your decisions carry real weight.


About the Role
  • Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, React and JavaScript, and deploy it via Heroku, Azure and AWS.
  • Take ownership of large, complex projects: from scoping and architecture through to delivery in close collaboration with the CTO.
  • Identify and address performance bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural weaknesses proactively.
  • Build and maintain robust API integrations with 3rd party software providers.
  • Lead by example in pull request culture; writing clear descriptions, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team.

  • Contribute to engineering standards, tooling decisions, and best practices as a senior voice on the team.


Why Work at StayFi?
  • You'll work directly with the CTO and CEO on mission-critical projects with real ownership and autonomy.
  • Your experience and judgment will directly shape the technical direction of the product.
  • You'll have an outsized impact both within our company and across the vacation rental industry  in a way that's rarely possible at larger organizations.
  • As you continue to help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.

  • You'll gain visibility into the full lifecycle of a sustainable, founder-led business well beyond just writing code.

title: FinCrime Escalations Officer
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Financial Crime Operations is at the forefront of Revolut’s efforts to keep customers and their money safe. Team members work directly with customers to resolve issues and flag potential concerns. Using cutting-edge technology and sharp attention to detail, they help prevent financial crime and keep trust at the core of Revolut.

We’re looking for an Escalations Officer to ensure effective and compliant suspicious activity reporting in Brazil. You'll be performing assessments and making decisions on cases, which are escalated from the first line of defence.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.


What you’ll be doing


  • Acting as the escalation point for suspicious activity cases
  • Ensuring accurate and timely SARs are submitted according to local requirements
  • Responding to regulatory inquiries and other requests from local authorities related to SARs
  • Managing queries requiring a second line of defence review
  • Working with the MLRO and escalating significant cases
  • Monitoring and detecting rare or new patterns, and reporting emerging trends in suspicious activity
  • Resolving escalated cases, following expected resolution times
  • Participating in projects with management as required
  • Collaborating on training initiatives and implementation of new processes


What you'll need


  • Experience as a compliance/FinCrime officer in a major financial institution
  • Experience in FinCrime operations acting as the escalation point
  • Deep knowledge of AML and sanctions regulations
  • Experience using internal and external systems and databases to conduct investigations
  • The ability to review policies and procedures and advise if changes are required
  • Problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to analyse complex information to identify the key issue/action and drive resolutions
  • The ability to present a summary and conclusion to management promptly, including clear proposals to implement appropriate steps to mitigate risk and/or monitor it
  • An understanding of payment systems and markets with a focus on technology and mobile applications
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese


We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

We're looking for a senior full-stack developer with a strong frontend orientation who is passionate about building modern, polished user interfaces — and who actively leverages generative AI tools to do so faster and better. You'll own the frontend experience end-to-end while contributing meaningfully to backend systems built in Python.

Hands-on experience with React and are comfortable working across the modern frontend ecosystem (Vue, Svelte, Angular, or similar). You use tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar AI coding platforms as a core part of your workflow — not as a novelty, but as a productivity multiplier. You can articulate how AI changes the way you architect, prototype, and ship frontend code. Ideally, you're genuinely excited about AI and follow the space closely.

On the backend, you bring strong Python skills. You've built APIs, worked with frameworks like FastAPI, Django, or Flask, and are comfortable with databases, authentication, and deployment. You don't just \"know some Python\" — you can design and build backend services confidently.


Key Requirements:

Hourly Rate: $60.00

Minimum Hours: No minimum

Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability


About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The Opportunity

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.

Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.


What you’ll be doing

When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:

  • Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
  • Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
  • Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.


What you’ll bring

  • Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
  • Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
  • Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
  • Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.


Why join this project?

This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour , you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.


We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.


We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.


Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again; simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities.

Nosso Cliente

Esta posição atuará em apoio ao nosso cliente, uma multinacional líder no segmento de cruzeiros marítimos.

title: Data Scientist - Sênior (Motor de Busca)
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na squad de Busca, com foco em Busca Semântica, relevância e ranking. Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução da experiência de busca, atuando desde a definição de hipóteses até a implementação, experimentação e mensuração de impacto, com forte interface com Produto, Engenharia e Negócio.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e evoluir soluções de Busca Semântica utilizando Elasticsearch, indo além da busca lexical tradicional.
  • Atuar na definição e otimização de: Estrutura de índices e mappings Estratégias de ranking híbrido (lexical + semântico) Queries semânticas (ex: embeddings, similarity search, boosting contextual)
  • Trabalhar com vetorização de conteúdo (produtos, termos de busca, atributos) para melhoria de relevância.
  • Avaliar e evoluir métricas de qualidade de busca. Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar impacto das melhorias semânticas. Traduzir problemas de negócio e experiência do usuário em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados.
  • Atuar em parceria com Engenharia e Produto na definição do roadmap técnico de busca. Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time, elevando o nível das discussões técnicas.


Requisitos necessários

  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins. Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados.
  • Experiência prática com Busca Semântica em Elasticsearch
  • Experiência com Information Retrieval (IR) e conceitos de relevância.
  • Conhecimento em NLP aplicado à busca (ex: embeddings, similaridade textual).
  • Experiência com modelos de ranking ou learning to rank.
  • Domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem.
  • Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto.
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume de dados. Noções de MLOps.
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.


Diferenciais

  • Vivência com BigQuery ou data lakes.
  • Experiência prévia em e-commerce, marketplace ou plataformas de discovery.
  • Experiência em observabilidade e monitoramento da qualidade da busca.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.


Perfil esperado

  • Forte mentalidade de produto e experiência do usuário.
  • Perfil analítico, curioso e orientado a impacto.
  • Autonomia para conduzir iniciativas complexas de ponta a ponta.
  • Capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas e de produto com dados.
  • Boa colaboração em times multidisciplinares.

title: Senior Voip Engineer
description:
About the role

We are hiring a Senior VoIP Engineer to help shape and evolve a large-scale real-time communications platform, including the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.

This role sits at the intersection of telecom, networking, and software engineering , and requires practical, production-grade experience across all three. You will contribute directly to architectural decisions, build new services, and improve voice systems that customers rely on every day.

This is a developer role — not an integrator or operator position. We are looking for someone who has written code that routes, manipulates, and reasons about SIP traffic at scale.

What you'll do

  • Design and develop services for a production-grade real-time communications platform.
  • Build and maintain telephony applications using open-source and commercial platforms.
  • Contribute to and help lead the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.
  • Design and implement call routing logic, SIP signaling flows, and media handling.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues in live voice environments — signaling, media, performance, and reliability.
  • Partner closely with operations and cross-functional engineering teams to ensure service stability and scalability.

What we're looking for:


Required

  • 5+ years as a developer building VoIP / SIP systems — not solely operating or integrating commercial platforms.
  • Hands-on production experience with both layers of an open-source SIP stack:

A B2BUA / media server: Asterisk or FreeSWITCH

A SIP proxy / routing layer: Kamailio or OpenSIPS

  • Proven track record building and operating voice platforms in production.
  • Solid understanding of SIP signaling, dialog state, NAT traversal, and real-time media behavior.
  • Comfort reading and writing code, not only configuration.
  • Advanced English proficiency (written and spoken).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.


Strong plus

  • Python for automation, tooling, or service development.
  • SQL and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Event-driven architectures and messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, NATS).
  • DevOps and automation tooling (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines).
  • Exposure to RTPengine, Homer SIP capture, WebRTC gateways, or SBCs.
  • Experience contributing to or maintaining infrastructure-as-code.


Why this role

  • Fully remote with a flexible working model.
  • Direct ownership of architectural decisions on a platform handling real production traffic.
  • High-impact migration project — your work shapes the next generation of the platform.
  • Tight, technical team where engineering quality is a first-class concern.
  • Continuous learning culture with support for training and development.

About LG Sonic: LG Sonic is a global leader in sustainable water quality management, dedicated to developing cutting-edge technologies that help protect water ecosystems. With operations in over 50 countries, we specialize in advanced solutions for algae control, water quality monitoring, and environmental protection. Our award-winning ultrasonic technology, combined with real-time data monitoring, empowers industries, municipalities, and governments to maintain clean and healthy water bodies while reducing chemical use. At LG Sonic, we foster a dynamic and innovative work environment, driven by a passion for sustainability and technological excellence. Join our team and be part of a mission to create cleaner water for future generations.

The Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician will be responsible for assembling, installing, and maintaining LG Sonic equipment at our clients' sites across various locations in Brazil. In addition to on-site technical duties, the professional will work remotely in an after-sales capacity, providing direct support and maintaining close communication with clients to ensure their needs are met effectively.

  • Travel to client sites as needed to address technical issues and provide on-site support.

  • Maintain direct and proactive communication with clients to ensure satisfaction and address their needs effectively.
  • Document all assembly, maintenance, and support activities, preparing detailed reports for internal records and client follow-ups.
  • Collaborate with the LG Sonic team to identify opportunities for equipment improvements or upgrades based on client feedback and field observations.

Qualification and requirements:

  • Proven experience in equipment assembly, installation, and maintenance, preferably in a technical or industrial setting.
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently in the field and remotely, with strong organizational and time-management skills.

Why Join LG Sonic? At LG Sonic, we offer an exciting and collaborative work environment where your contributions directly impact our mission of environmental sustainability and innovation. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to grow professionally while being a part of a global leader in water treatment technology. We believe in investing in our people and fostering an inclusive culture where every team member’s ideas are valued.


LG Sonic Values : Unity, Trust, Positivism, Over deliver and Passion.

title: Data Engineer III
description:

O(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados terá um papel crítico no desenho, construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados robustos, modelos de dados e ativos fundamentais que suportam analytics, relatórios e capacidades emergentes de IA/ML. Essa função exige forte rigor em engenharia, profundo entendimento de sistemas de dados e capacidade de colaborar entre equipes técnicas e de negócio.

O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui um histórico comprovado na construção de soluções de dados escaláveis em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, e sente-se confortável equilibrando trabalho em plataformas de dados fundamentais com iniciativas em evolução de analytics e IA.


O que você fará

Você possui uma forte mentalidade de engenharia e resolução de problemas. Converte necessidades de negócio e analíticas em soluções e arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e confiáveis.

Projeta, constrói e mantém pipelines e modelos de dados escaláveis que suportam monitoramento de desempenho do negócio, analytics e relatórios, além de contribuir para o desenvolvimento da Base de Dados BMP em ambientes Hive, Snowflake e data lakes.

Apoia o desenvolvimento de produtos e aplicações de dados, incluindo contribuição em pipelines baseados em Streamlit e no desenvolvimento de capacidades de chatbot para melhorar o acesso e a interação com dados.

Colabora de perto com equipes de analytics, ciência de dados e áreas de negócio para garantir disponibilidade, qualidade e usabilidade dos dados para dashboards, relatórios e análises avançadas.

Viabiliza e apoia o desenvolvimento de analytics avançado, machine learning e capacidades de IA, garantindo que a infraestrutura, pipelines e ambientes necessários estejam disponíveis para o desenvolvimento e implantação de modelos.

Contribui para o design e evolução do ecossistema de dados e ML, ajudando a estabelecer infraestrutura, processos e fundamentos necessários para escalar iniciativas de IA/ML na organização.


Qualificações Mínimas

• Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia ou área quantitativa relacionada.

• Mais de 5 anos de experiência em engenharia de dados, desenvolvimento de plataformas de dados ou funções relacionadas.

• Forte experiência com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação (Python ou equivalente).

• Familiaridade com frameworks de big data e processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / PySpark).

• Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados e trabalho com arquiteturas modernas de dados.

• Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow) e automação de pipelines.

• Experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS) e soluções de data warehouse (ex.: Snowflake).

• Sólido entendimento de modelagem de dados, qualidade de dados e governança de dados.

• Experiência com sistemas de controle de versão (Git) e fluxos colaborativos de desenvolvimento.

• Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e capacidade de trabalhar com requisitos ambíguos.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de colaborar com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.

• Inglês fluente.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Gerente de Aterro Sanitário | Biogás
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Liderar a operação de biogás e biometano , desde o campo de gás até a entrega do produto para o parceiro terceirizado.
  • Gerir times de campo e escritório , incluindo operação 24 horas da planta.
  • Atuar de forma integrada com as áreas de Aterro, Chorume e Logística.
  • Garantir a performance operacional, segurança, continuidade e eficiência da planta.
  • Desenvolver e executar o plano de crescimento do negócio de biogás , apoiando o aumento de receita.
  • Atuar como peça-chave na estratégia de expansão do grupo no setor de resíduos , com potencial de participação em novos projetos e ativos do Regenera.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente a evolução da operação, considerando a mudança tecnológica do setor (de geração de energia para purificação de biogás e produção de biometano).
  • Conduzir análises de viabilidade técnica e econômica para expansão de capacidade, purificação para biometano ou ampliação da geração de energia.
  • Profissional com experiência comprovada em gás combustível de fonte renovável e Unidade de disposição final de resíduos sólidos, com atuação direta na gestão, monitoramento e análise de indicadores operacionais e ambientais do sistema de extração e aproveitamento energético do gás gerado por digestão anaeróbia.
  • Sólida vivência em sítios de destinação final ambientalmente controlados, incluindo controle de eficiência de captação, monitoramento de vazão, pressão, teor de metano (CH₄), oxigênio (O₂) e demais parâmetros críticos de desempenho.
  • Experiência na operação e manutenção da Unidade de Captação e Queima, com acompanhamento de KPIs como disponibilidade do sistema,controle de emissões e performance de flares.
  • Implementar planos de manutenção preventiva e preditiva.
  • Coordenar equipes multidisciplinares (operação, manutenção, meio ambiente e engenharia).
  • Sólida vivência com controle e atendimento ao monitoramento do projeto de MDL.


Informações adicionais

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.


Disponibilidade para atuar em Seropédica, Rio de Janeiro/RJ

De segunda a sexta das 8h às 18h

title: Account Manager
description:
As an Account Manager for Brazil , you'll join our passionate and supportive team characterised by our ambition and team spirit. You'll have the freedom to work independently while fostering strong collaboration with our content and product departments.


You'll be responsible for driving the entire sales and success cycle in the iGaming market, from initial engagement to maximizing long-term results. Managing key client relationships, driving sales growth, and ensuring customer satisfaction within these specific regions. This role requires a proactive approach to identifying opportunities, understanding client needs, and delivering tailored solutions that drive mutual success.


Specifically, your role will involve:


  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key clients, including sports betting operators, casinos, online gaming platforms, and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for key client accounts, managing all aspects of the client relationship and serving as their trusted advisor.
  • Understand clients' business objectives, market trends, and regulatory requirements specific to the English speaking markets to effectively position our gambling products and services.
  • Collaborate with internal sales, marketing, and product development teams to customize solutions and address client needs within these regions.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for upselling additional products/services and expanding client accounts.
  • Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations, proposals, and business cases to key clients within these regions.
  • Monitor and analyze sales performance, market trends, and competitor activities to identify opportunities for growth and optimization within key accounts.
  • Attend industry events, conferences, and trade shows worldwide to network with key clients and stay informed about industry insights and developments.
  • Provide timely and accurate reports on key account performance, sales activity, and revenue forecasts within these regions to management.
  • Stay up-to-date on gambling regulations, compliance standards, and responsible gaming practices to ensure adherence and mitigate risks.


The ideal profile


We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:


  • Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Brazilian Portuguese and English.
  • Understand gambling products, platforms, and regulations in specific regions.
  • Drive change and support accounts in the iGaming industry with your sales skills.
  • Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast-paced environments.
  • Focus on exceeding sales targets and driving revenue growth.
  • Bring experience in iGaming strategy, sales, or affiliate management.
  • Excel in building and maintaining strong relationships with partners.
  • Possess excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Show active listening, resilience, and persistence.
  • Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and effective task coordination.
  • Excel in time management, organization, and planning.
  • Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously.
  • Use analytical skills and a data-driven mindset for decision-making.
  • Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments.
  • Be open to occasional travel for client meetings and industry events.


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • First Interview: A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements.
  • Second Interview: A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media.
  • Final Step: A proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • Remote Work Environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time.
  • Flexible Schedule: We measure results , not hours, and offer paid time off.
  • Development Opportunities: As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path.
  • Team Gatherings: Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun . We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone.
  • Wellness Fund: €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.

title: Senior .Net Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Software Engineer (Contractor)

Job Type: Full-time (Remote)

Pay: R$20,000.00 – R$22,000.00 per month


Resume:

English version only.

Highlight SAAS projects, healthcare related projects, and HIPAA experience.

Highlight experiences in .NET MVC and .NET Maui


Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer contractor to join our U.S.-based team remotely. You will leverage your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects.

In this role, you will work on our healthcare platform, gaining deep system knowledge and contributing to our Agile workflow via Azure DevOps . You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews , expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. Your role will evolve based on your strengths and our needs — all while adhering to rigorous coding and security standards .


Key Responsibilities

1. Product Design & Development

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to design software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancing existing codebases (opportunities starting around months 3–4).

2. Testing & Quality

  • Design and implement automated End-to-End (E2E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability — with a strong focus during your first 6–9 months.

3. Peer Reviews & Post-Release Support

  • Participate in pre-release feature reviews (ongoing).
  • Conduct initial post-release bug ticket analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.

4. Agile Collaboration

  • Actively contribute to 2-week sprints and 6-week release cycles (3 sprints per release).
  • Participate in sprint planning, pull requests, releases, and daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT).

5. Communication & Coordination

  • Collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical team members across time zones.


Qualifications

Experience

  • 8 years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record on complex projects.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Application (.NET 8) for mobile and web development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure (Azure App Service, Azure SQL, Azure Storage).
  • Proficient with modern development tools (Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with healthcare software or Protected Health Information standards (e.g., HIPAA).
  • Experience with pull request reviews and sprint participation.


How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: 2-week sprints, 6-week release cycles, daily stand-ups at 3:00 PM CT.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tools: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and more.
  • Team Culture: Accountability, quality, and excellence in delivery.

title: Professor de francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

Eles testam, ajustam e solucionam problemas de componentes, PCBs, subconjuntos e antenas, bem como carregam, atualizam e modificam o software. Os Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo utilizam seus conhecimentos de teoria e circuitos eletrônicos para resolver uma variedade de problemas técnicos, bem como para fazer uso inteligente de esquemas complexos, projetos e manuais para realizar tarefas com precisão. Após a conclusão de cada trabalho, o técnico redigirá e enviará um relatório de serviço detalhado.

• Girobússola

• Pilotos automáticos

• Sirenes

• Proficiente em falar, ler e escrever em inglês.

• Forte conhecimento de teoria e aplicação de eletrônica.

title: Finance Analyst - Collection, Finance
description:
About Voxy


Voxy, established in 2010, is an innovative language training platform designed to address the unique language requirements of global organizations. Aiming to boost productivity, encourage collaboration, and unlock human potential, Voxy has positioned itself as a worldwide leader in corporate language training. Voxy has built a strong foundation and a continually developing vision, assisting corporate clients in 150 nations through live language coaching by certified teachers and a vast selection of role-specific courses that address essential soft and technical skill deficiencies.


Currently, Voxy's influence reaches worldwide, with committed teams working in various locations such as the United States, Brazil, Chile, Mexico, Thailand, Malaysia, Spain, Italy, and Ireland. Initially concentrated on English language teaching, Voxy has expanded to provide various languages, such as Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, German, and French, serving a wide variety of learners.


We think that acquiring a language ought to be enjoyable, fulfilling, and a pathway to the finest experiences life presents. If you’re on board, we would be happy to discuss.


You can find additional information about our values at this link (


The Impact You’ll Have at Voxy

Growth brings complexity. This role exists to ensure our financial operations keep pace, reducing DSO, identifying risks early, and resolving payment issues before they escalate.


What You’ll Be Doing:

Collections & Cash Application:

• Performs daily collection activities on overdue customer accounts through outbound calls, emails, and correspondence following established dunning schedules and escalation protocols.

• Monitors AR aging reports and prioritizes collection efforts based on balance size, days past due, customer risk profile, and strategic account importance.

• Investigates and resolves customer billing disputes by coordinating with Sales, AM/KAM, Billing, and Contract Administration teams; documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system.

• Negotiates payment plans and settlement arrangements with customers within approved parameters; tracks compliance with agreed terms and escalates non-performing arrangements to the FP&A Manager.

• Applies incoming customer payments (checks, ACH, wire transfers) to open invoices in the AR sub-ledger; investigates and resolves unapplied cash, short payments, and overpayments.

• Prepares and sends customer account statements, past-due notices, and collection letters per company dunning policies.

• Processes customer write-offs and bad debt adjustments per approval policies; prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions.


Credit Analysis & Risk Management:

• Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history; recommends credit limits and payment terms.

• Monitors customer credit exposure and concentration risk; flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior.

• Maintains accurate customer credit files and ensures compliance with internal credit policies and approval hierarchies.


Reporting & Analysis:

• Prepares weekly and monthly collection status reports, aging summaries, DSO analysis, and cash collection forecasts for management review.

• Tracks and reports on collection KPIs including collection effectiveness index, roll rates, promise-to-pay conversion rates, and bad debt write-off trends.

• Supports month-end AR close activities including revenue accruals, bad debt provisions, credit memo processing, and sub-ledger-to-GL reconciliation.

• Assists with ad-hoc analysis and special projects as directed by the FP&A Manager or Senior FP&A Analyst.


What We’re Looking For:

• B.A/B.S. Degree - Accounting or Business Administration;

• 2+ years accounting and/or finance experience, with prior/current internship in accounting;

• Organized, process-oriented and meticulous attention to details;

• Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment and someone who is eager to learn, contribute as a team member and do more and to progress in the company;

• Advanced Excel skills. Experience with macros/VBA is a plus;

• Based anywhere in Brazil

• Capable of writing and reading in both English and Spanish

• Experience with tech company, preferably Enterprise Saas, is a plus.


Job Details:

• Gross Salary: R$110,500/year

• Working Hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm (GMT-3)


In addition to a rewarding job that that will directly impact how millions of students learn English, working here, you’ll enjoy:

• Competitive salary (base/commission/bonus/equity)

• Great benefits: medical insurance, cell phone & wifi reimbursement, home office & wellness budget, team events

• Remote friendly work policies

• Professional development budget

• Language classes w/ Voxy & Fluentify

• Work with an awesome international team of super bright, creative, talented, and passionate individuals based around the world

• Time Zones: ET(Eastern Time), BRT(Brasilia Time), SAMT(Samara Standard Time), Central European Time (CET)


We believe in a workplace that is meant for everyone. Voxy is an equal opportunity employer.


Voxy believes that a creative, engaged and diverse team can transform the market and positively impact people's lives through education. We are sure that the mission of building the most effective way to learn English is done with a plurality of ideas and points of view, which is why we work to promote Diversity, Equity and Inclusion initiatives in our company.


In addition to training, benchmarking, and community partnerships, we also work in alignment with our internal DEI Committee.


As a reflection of our beliefs around inclusion in the workplace, our selection process has no restrictions; our goal is to assemble a diverse team that will help us be leaders in our market.


We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. Learn more about our DEI initiatives and ERGs by clicking here.

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
Senior Software Engineer I, L3 Messaging Team (Remote)

We're recruiting a Senior Software Engineer I to own the technical direction of a mission-critical messaging platform serving hundreds of healthcare organizations across the United States.


THE ROLE

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. They've built the leading platform powering communications for underserved populations, with proven impact reaching millions. Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent.


You'll own complex features end-to-end, drive architectural decisions that shape how millions of patient communications are delivered, and share team lead responsibilities with your peers. This is a highly visible, technically autonomous role with direct impact on health equity outcomes.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years hands-on backend engineering with Ruby on Rails at scale
  • Deep experience building, maintaining, and scaling APIs and distributed systems
  • Advanced SQL skills and comfort working with large, complex datasets
  • Proven ability to independently own complex projects end-to-end and mentor junior engineers
  • Data-driven mindset you rely on evidence, not intuition
  • Excellent communicator (especially in fully remote environments)
  • Passionate about mission-driven work and advancing health equity


BONUS POINTS

  • Experience with Twilio, RCS, or MMS messaging platforms
  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance (TCPA, consent workflows, carrier regulations)
  • Tech stack: React, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Sidekiq
  • Event-driven architecture or high-throughput message delivery pipelines


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and drive the technical direction of key messaging platform features
  • Design and build backend messaging systems (delivery pipelines, consent management, scheduling orchestration, API integrations)
  • Mentor L2 engineers, lead technical design discussions, and set engineering standards
  • Contribute to architectural decisions that shape messaging infrastructure at scale
  • Participate in on-call rotations (PagerDuty) and help improve team processes
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Data teams


YOUR IMPACT

  • Month 1: Master the platform architecture and contribute to technical design discussions
  • Month 3: Independently deliver complex features with meaningful impact on patient outcomes
  • Month 6: Be recognized as a technical leader driving strategic initiatives across the engineering department

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang)
description:
OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA


Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations

Company:  Fulcrum SaaS

Location: Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required)

Type:  Full-time

Level:  Senior / Staff

Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location


About Fulcrum SaaS

Fulcrum SaaS is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant SaaS environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.

Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.


The Role

We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.

You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.

You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.
  • Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.
  • Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/BigQuery or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.
  • Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.
  • Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.
  • Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.


What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)

  • 5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).
  • Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.
  • Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.
  • Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/BigQuery strongly preferred; Cassandra, DynamoDB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.
  • Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.
  • Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.
  • Multi-tenant SaaS experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.
  • Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.
  • Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.
  • Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).


Strong Nice-to-Haves

  • Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).
  • A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.
  • Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.
  • Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.


What We Offer

  • Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.
  • Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.
  • Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.
  • A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.


How to Apply

Please apply through LinkedIn with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:

  • Your experience with Go in production.
  • The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.
  • Your country of residence and preferred start date.

You can also include links to GitHub, technical blogs, or talks if available.
