title: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo

NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.

NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.

We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.

Role and responsibilities

The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.

The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.


Primary roles and responsibilities include:

Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management

  • Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
  • Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
  • Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
  • Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.

Eligibility, due diligence & agreements

  • Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
  • Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
  • Lead closure of contract signatures.
  • Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system

(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).

Reforestation delivery enablement

  • Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
  • Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
  • Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
  • Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).

Stakeholder engagement and safeguards

  • Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
  • Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism.
  • Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
  • Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.

Reporting

  • Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
  • Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

Teamwork and culture

  • Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
  • Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.


Skills and attributes

To perform successfully in this role, you will have:

  • A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
  • Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
  • Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
  • Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
  • A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
  • Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
  • A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.


Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.


Location

  • Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia


Submission instructions

  • Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
  • Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Analista de Employer Branding e Comunicação Interna Senior
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR).

Dentro desse ecossistema de soluções, a Equipo Locadora é especialista em soluções personalizadas para empresas que precisam de transporte sem complicações, oferecendo tecnologia, gestão inteligente de frota e atendimento próximo aos clientes. Com o objetivo de oferecer transporte inteligente e eficiente para empresas de diferentes portes e segmentos, sempre com foco em qualidade, confiabilidade e inovação.

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

title: Gerente de contas
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

title: Arquiteto Sênior SAP Basis e Infraestrutura

description:

Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.

  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.

title: Médico Gastroenterologista
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO GASTROENTEROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Gastroenterologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.


  • Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.



REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA (ou em andamento) OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA).


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho); ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência médica. Pós ou Especialização na área;
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);


Experiência:

  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em gastroenterologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO


Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.



IMPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

title: Institutional Relations Manager
description:
Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding is a visionary industry leader that focuses on innovation while supporting growth with an emphasis on economic and environmental sustainability across a wide range of industries, primarily energy and shipbuilding.


Operating in more than 20 countries, with over 3,000 employees from 30 different nationalities and an installed capacity exceeding 8,000 MW, the Group generates reliable and clean electricity across four continents through its fleet of 45 Powerships™ and 11 LNG vessels, providing employment to more than 10,000 people worldwide. Karadeniz Holding manages its Powership™ fleet under its international brand Karpowership, meeting between 10% and 100% of the electricity needs of the countries where it operates across Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Asia. With high-capacity energy solutions, including Powership™, land-based plants, and floating LNG infrastructure, Karpowership supports countries and companies in their energy transition processes.


We are looking for an Institutional Relations Manager to join our operations in Brazil, based at our Rio de Janeiro office.


WHAT DO WE EXPECT?


• Bachelor’s degree in Law, Economics, Engineering, Business Administration or related fields; postgraduate degree or MBA will be considered a plus,

• Minimum of 8 years of experience in institutional, governmental, or regulatory affairs, preferably within the energy sector (power generation, natural gas, oil & gas, or infrastructure),

• Strong knowledge of the Brazilian regulatory environment, especially in the electricity and natural gas sectors, including interaction with entities such as ANEEL, ONS, and MME,

• Proven experience in managing relationships with key stakeholders (government, regulators, associations, and institutional partners),

• Advanced English (spoken and written),

• Strong communication, negotiation, and influencing skills in complex and multicultural environments,

• Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret regulatory scenarios and anticipate risks and opportunities,

• Leadership skills, project management capabilities, and ability to work cross-functionally,

• Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and handle strategic topics,

• High ethical standards and alignment with compliance and corporate governance practices,

• Proactive profile with autonomy and ability to develop strategic and innovative solutions.


WHAT AWAITS YOU?


• Lead and execute KPS Brazil’s institutional and governmental relations strategy, ensuring alignment with business and regulatory objectives,

• Develop and maintain strategic relationships with government bodies, regulators, and industry entities, including ANEEL, ONS, MME, IBAMA, and other relevant stakeholders,

• Continuously monitor and analyze the regulatory and institutional landscape of the electricity and natural gas sectors in Brazil, anticipating risks and opportunities,

• Proactively represent and defend the company’s interests in public consultations, hearings, and regulatory forums,

• Coordinate licensing processes, authorizations, and institutional interactions required for project implementation, operation, and continuity (including Powerships and onshore assets),

• Structure and implement stakeholder engagement strategies at local, regional, and national levels, including governments, communities, and strategic partners,

• Support institutional and contractual negotiations with public authorities and regulatory bodies, ensuring legal compliance and risk mitigation,

• Work closely with legal, regulatory, commercial, and operational teams to ensure consistency in the company’s institutional positioning,

• Manage institutional crises and sensitive matters, ensuring effective communication and strategic positioning,

• Lead the preparation of strategic reports and executive analyses on the regulatory and institutional environment to support senior leadership decision-making,

• Represent the company in industry associations, chambers of commerce, and energy sector forums, strengthening KPS’s institutional presence in Brazil,

• Ensure compliance with corporate governance, ethics, and compliance guidelines in all institutional interactions.


WHAT DO WE OFFER?


• Hybrid working model,

• One day off on your birthday,

• Private health insurance (extended to dependents) and life insurance,

• Variable compensation package and performance-based bonus,

• Meal allowance + food allowance in line with market practices,

• Mobility benefits (transport allowance and parking policy),

• Well-being and quality of life programs, including TotalPass,

• Professional and personal training and development opportunities,

• Multicultural environment with exposure to international projects,

• Opportunity to contribute to strategic energy transition projects.


In line with our \"One World\" philosophy, we are adding success to our achievements with our colleagues, candidates, and all stakeholders. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all applicants, regardless of race, religion, language or gender and we crown our success with our diversity.

title: Commercial Lead — Brazil
description:
About Regrow

Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.



About the Role

As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.


You will work closely with our Head of LatAm, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.


This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.



What You’ll Do

  • Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.
  • Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.
  • Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.
  • Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.
  • Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.
  • Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.
  • Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.



What You’ll Bring

  • Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2B environments.
  • Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.
  • Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.
  • Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.
  • Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or SaaS platforms.
  • Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.
  • Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.
  • Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts.
  • Native or near-native Portuguese fluency.
  • Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly.
  • Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.



Nice to Have

  • Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.
  • Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.
  • Working knowledge of Spanish.



Why Regrow

  • Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.
  • High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.
  • A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits.



Acerca de Regrow

Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.


Sobre el Rol

Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.


Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de LatAm, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.


Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.


Qué Harás

  • Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre.
  • Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas.
  • Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast.
  • Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras.
  • Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.
  • Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.
  • Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.
  • Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.



Qué Aportarás

  • Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2B complejos.
  • Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo.
  • Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial.
  • Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.
  • Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas SaaS.
  • Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional.
  • Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.
  • Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.
  • Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.
  • Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.
  • Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.



Deseable

  • Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento.
  • Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales.
  • Conocimiento funcional del español.



Por Qué Regrow

  • Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala.
  • Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real.
  • Un equipo global colaborativo que combina experiencia comercial, científica y técnica.
  • Compensación y beneficios competitivos.

title: Tech - Delivery Manager
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

  • Realizar avaliações técnicas dos projetos (arquitetura, qualidade de código, automação, maturidade DevOps) e propor ações de melhoria com base em evidências.

O que você precisa ter

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.

Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.

Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.


Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.


THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.



What You’ll Do

  • Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
  • Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
  • UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
  • Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
  • Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
  • Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
  • The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
  • The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
  • The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
  • The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
  • The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.


Key Skills

  • Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.
  • Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.
  • AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.
  • Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.
  • Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.
  • Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
  • Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.


Be fully aligned with our core values:

Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.


By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
  • Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.


OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Customer Loyalty Specialist
description:
About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. We’re building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?


About you:

This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Loyalty Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you’ll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.


What You’ll Own:

  • Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue.
  • You’ll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI.
  • Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines.
  • Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved.
  • Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value.
  • Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured “silent churn” playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces.
  • Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.

title: Principal .Net Architect
description:

You will lead the architectural evolution of a business-critical platform, focusing on improving scalability, security, and maintainability . This includes defining a modern target architecture and supporting the transition from legacy systems to cloud-ready solutions .

Collaboration is key — you will work closely with cross-functional teams across engineering, product, and infrastructure, while also supporting Agile delivery by translating architecture into clear technical tasks.

You will regularly communicate with senior stakeholders, providing clear updates on progress, risks, and technical decisions.


Key Skills Required

  • Strong experience with C# and .NET architecture (modern and legacy systems)
  • Proven expertise in Identity & Access Management (IAM)
  • Solid understanding of OAuth2, OIDC, and JWT protocols
  • Experience with platform modernisation (cloud migration, refactoring, system upgrades)
  • Strong background in distributed and cloud-native architectures
  • Knowledge of APIs, microservices, and integration patterns
  • Experience working in Agile (Scrum / Kanban) environments

title: Senior .NET and AI Engineer
description:

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer with strong .NET expertise and hands-on AI experience. In this role, you will build and deliver cloud-native applications while actively using AI tools and integrating AI capabilities into products.


This is not a junior position. We are looking for engineers who take ownership, think critically, and deliver real impact.


What You Will Do

  • Develop scalable applications using .NET, ASP.NET Core and Blazor
  • Build cloud-based solutions on Azure
  • Design and optimize APIs and database structures
  • Use AI tools to improve development speed and quality
  • Build and integrate AI-powered features into products


What We Are Looking For

  • 4+ years of professional C# / .NET development experience
  • Strong ASP.NET Core fundamentals — Web API, middleware, dependency injection, minimal APIs
  • Blazor experience (WebAssembly and/or Server) — production experience preferred
  • Azure services: App Service, Static Web Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, or similar
  • Entity Framework Core — schema design, migrations, query optimization, and knowing when NOT to use the ORM
  • SQL proficiency: query writing, indexing, and diagnosing performance issues
  • Solid REST API design and consumption patterns
  • Git-based workflows: branching strategies, PR culture, code review


Testing (Emphasized)

  • Strong experience with unit, integration and end-to-end testing
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as xUnit or NUnit and mocking libraries
  • Experience with integration testing approaches such as TestServer or similar
  • Familiarity with end-to-end testing tools such as Playwright is a plus
  • Ability to design meaningful test scenarios and prioritize quality over coverage metrics


AI-Assisted Development

  • Active use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar in daily work
  • Strong prompt writing skills and ability to guide AI effectively
  • Experience using AI for code generation, refactoring, documentation and code review
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure code quality
  • Keeping up to date with evolving AI tools and applying them in development workflows


Building AI-Powered Features

  • Experience integrating LLM APIs into applications
  • Understanding of AI-driven workflows and agent-based systems
  • Familiarity with concepts such as RAG, semantic search or vector databases
  • Ability to evaluate AI outputs and design reliable user-facing features
  • Awareness of data privacy and security considerations when working with AI


Nice to Have

  • Azure AI services and monitoring tools
  • CI/CD pipeline experience
  • Experience in healthcare or regulated environments


Who You Are

  • You write clean and maintainable code
  • You take ownership and deliver end-to-end
  • You focus on building rather than discussing
  • You are curious, proactive and open to continuous learning


If you enjoy building real products and working with modern technologies, we would be happy to hear from you.

description:
We are seeking a UX / Senior Product Designer to define the user experience for our AI-powered procurement platforms. You will design the interfaces that allow thousands of employees to interact with \"agentic\" workflows, turning complex supply chain logic into intuitive, guided digital experiences.

What You Will Do

● Product & Interface Strategy: Architect the user journey for complex, end-to-end internal applications. You will take ownership of the UX for major platform features, ensuring they are intuitive and resilient to user error.

● Frontend-Aligned Design: Design responsive, highly interactive, and accessible UIs. You will work closely with engineers to ensure designs account for complex global states and performance optimization.

● Information Architecture: Design robust flows for procurement data. You will architect how users navigate high-density enterprise information, making it scannable and actionable.

● AI Interaction Design (AWS Bedrock Integration): Design the \"Human-in-the-Loop\" patterns for our AI features. You will create the UI that helps users trust and verify AI-generated procurement suggestions and RAG-driven insights.

● Systems Thinking: Maintain and evolve our internal design system. You will ensure that AI-assisted workflows feel like a natural, cohesive extension of the Rivian digital ecosystem.

● AI-Assisted Design: Utilize modern AI design tools to accelerate the generation of variants and assets, while focusing your human effort on high-level UX strategy, user research, and complex problem-solving.


Requirements & Tooling

● Design Tools: Mastery of Figma , including advanced prototyping and design system management.

● Frontend Literacy: A deep understanding of React/TypeScript capabilities so your designs are technically feasible and \"developer-ready.\"

● AI UX Frameworks: Experience designing for LLM interactions (handling latency, showing AI \"thought processes,\" and providing feedback loops).

● Prototyping: Proficiency in tools like Protopie, Framer, or high-fidelity Figma prototyping to demonstrate multi-step agentic logic.

● Testing: Experience collaborating on usability testing and using feedback to iterate on complex enterprise tools.


What We’re Looking For

● Experience: Product Design, specifically within B2B SaaS, Fintech, or complex internal enterprise tools.

● Architecture Focus: You possess the ability to simplify massive data sets and multi-step manual processes into clean, automated paths.

● Collaborative Mindset: You work seamlessly with engineers, understanding that the best designs are those that are safely and effectively deployed.

● Language Requirements: Advanced English and Portuguese proficiency for daily communication

title: AI Development Orchestrator
description:
Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time

Reports to: CEO

Stack: TypeScript, Python, React (Next.js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git

Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users

Start: Immediate


The Company

Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.


The Role

You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems; the agents think in code.

Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem; the strongest output is selected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.


What You Do

  • Review every AI-generated commit. Not \"does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\"
  • Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear.
  • Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage.
  • Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent.
  • Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix.
  • Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.


Must-Haves

  • Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer; the AI is the author.
  • Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant.
  • TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems.
  • React in production. Next.js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns.
  • Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it.
  • Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down.
  • Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations.
  • Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.


Strong Signals

  • Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison.
  • Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code).
  • Database-level access control in production.
  • Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling.
  • OWASP Top 10 fluency.
  • Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.


Red Flags

  • AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you.
  • Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance.
  • Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify.
  • Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review.
  • Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack.
  • Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership.
  • No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.


Who This Person Is

3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant.

You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.


How We Evaluate

No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing.

  • Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom?
  • Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything.
  • Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output?
  • AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.


What We Offer

  • A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access.
  • The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory.
  • Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately.
  • A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only.
  • A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI; quality comes from you.


To Apply or Refer

Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

title: Especialista de Conteúdo
description:
ESPECIALISTA DE CONTEÚDO

  • Autonomia real para construir, testar e escalar

SOBRE A ADAFLOW

A Adaflow nasceu para simplificar a vida de quem presta serviços no Brasil ou no exterior.


Ajudamos profissionais e empresas a abrir CNPJ, emitir notas fiscais e cuidar da rotina contábil, sem perder horas com a prefeitura, cartórios, sistemas confusos e burocracias que tiram energia de quem deveria estar focado em crescer.


Combinamos tecnologia, automação e atendimento humano para transformar a contabilidade em uma experiência simples, segura e eficiente.


Conheça mais em:


E agora a gente precisa de alguém que faça com que o conteúdo transmita essa mesma mensagem.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

Você vai ser dono(a) do conteúdo da Adaflow. Ponto. Não é executar briefings dos outros, é construir e rodar a estratégia com autonomia real.

Na prática, isso significa:

  • Estratégia e produção de conteúdo orgânico — definir pauta, produzir e distribuir conteúdo para blog, newsletter e redes sociais (LinkedIn, Instagram e o que mais fizer sentido). Cada peça precisa ter uma tese clara, um objetivo definido e uma métrica de sucesso. 
  • Conteúdo SEO-driven que converte intenção em tráfego — produzir conteúdo estratégico para blog e páginas, focado em transformar a intenção de busca em tráfego qualificado. 
  • Pesquisa de palavras-chave e otimização on-page — desenvolver pautas com base em keyword research, estruturar heading tags com hierarquia clara, otimizar meta-tags, title, description e a estrutura de URL.
  • IA como parte do processo — usar ferramentas de IA para escalar pesquisa, primeiras versões, variações e distribuição. Você decide onde a IA entra e sai, mantendo a qualidade editorial no padrão da marca.
  • Régua de comunicação com clientes — desenhar e operar a comunicação recorrente com a base: e-mail marketing, avisos de obrigações fiscais, atualizações de produto, comunicados importantes. Cadência, segmentação e copy são suas responsabilidades.
  • Apoio direto às vendas e ao marketing — produzir LPs, VSLs e fluxos de ativação junto com Growth.
  • Gestão dos próprios projetos — você organiza prazo, escopo e prioridade no Notion/ClickUp, comunica status sem precisar ser cobrada(o) e entrega com contexto.
  • Guardiã(o) do tom de voz e do posicionamento — garantir que tudo o que sai da Adaflow soe como Adaflow, em qualquer canal. Você define guidelines, revisa o que outras áreas publicam quando faz sentido e protege a consistência da marca.
  • Colaboração real com Branding e Growth — o modelo de gestão compartilhada significa que você participa das decisões estratégicas, traz dados e perspectiva editorial. O problema do time é também seu problema.


O QUE A GENTE PROCURA

  • Experiência sólida em conteúdo digital, de ponta a ponta: blog, newsletter e mídias.
  • Curiosidade ativa com IA aplicada à criação de conteúdo: você testa novas ferramentas por conta própria, tem opinião sobre quais usar e pra quê, e está sempre experimentando o que acabou de sair.
  • Repertório de ferramentas é parte do jogo. O stack que essa cadeira costuma rodar passa por: IA e automação de conteúdo (Automarticles, Greatapps, Lovable, Typebot), gestão de projetos (Notion, ClickUp), design (Figma, Canva), SEO (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Surfer), newsletter e e-mail (Substack, Beehiiv, Mailchimp, RD Station), social (Metricool, Buffer) e análise (GA4, Hotjar). Não precisa ter rodado todas, precisa ter repertório e saber escolher a ferramenta certa pro problema certo.
  • Escrita excelente, com repertório para transitar entre formatos e tons sem perder a voz da marca.
  • Capacidade de tocar projeto sozinho(a).
  • Visão analítica: você precisa considerar CAC, engajamento, tráfego orgânico e conversão como parte do seu trabalho.
  • Comunicação direta, pública e clara.


DIFERENCIAIS

  • Automação de marketing e CRM.
  • Vivência em startup ou scale-up de ritmo acelerado, você sabe o que é prazo apertado e prioridade que muda.


NEM TODO MUNDO FOI FEITO PARA ESSE RITMO

Se você quer um lugar onde alguém te diz exatamente o que escrever, precisa de reuniões intermináveis para tomar decisões ou prefere distribuir responsabilidade do que ser dono do resultado, existem boas empresas pra isso. Essa não é uma delas.


Mas se você quer construir a comunicação de uma empresa de tecnologia que está reinventando a contabilidade do Brasil, com automação de ponta, evoluir com gente que coloca a régua pra cima e ter ownership real do que produz, então queremos conhecer você!

title: Business Development Representative
description:
Business Development Representative (BDR)


About Us

XDRhub is a specialized sales and business development outsourcing company. We are professional cold-callers dedicated to helping small and mid-sized businesses grow through tailored outbound strategies. Our mission is simple: empower our clients to thrive in today’s competitive marketplace by building their pipelines with high-quality opportunities.


About the Role

As a Business Development Representative (BDR) , you will represent one of our clients and act as the first point of contact for prospective buyers. Your primary responsibility is to proactively identify, engage, and qualify decision-makers (Directors, VPs, and C-level executives).

This role is highly outbound-driven: you will spend your time cold calling, cold emailing, prospecting via LinkedIn, and using modern sales tools to generate meetings. You’ll run early-stage discovery conversations and hand off qualified opportunities to the sales team.

You’ll be working in a fast-paced environment where communication, persistence, and organization are key.


About You

We are looking for a driven, articulate communicator who thrives in outbound sales.

  • English Proficiency – Excellent oral and written English (C1 level or higher). Native-like fluency is required, as you will be speaking directly with US-based executives.
  • Sales Mindset – Fearless hunter mentality with a proven ability to prospect, cold call, and build pipeline.
  • Experience with Sales Solutions(Preferred) – Prior experience engaging HR and Finance executives is a strong plus.
  • Curious & Coachable – Eager to learn and grow; open to feedback, with the ambition to become a top 5% sales professional through our mentoring and training.
  • Self-Starter – Comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with team members.
  • Tech-Savvy – Familiar with tools like Salesforce, HubSpot, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar sales enablement platforms.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving environment .


Key Responsibilities

Lead Generation

  • Research and identify prospective buyers within target accounts.
  • Cold call and email Director and above level executives to secure meetings and demos.

Team Coordination

  • Work closely with Account Executives to confirm appointments, share call notes, and ensure smooth handoffs.
  • Communicate relevant insights from discovery calls to support the sales team’s success.

Data Management

  • Maintain accurate records of outreach, leads, conversations, and pipeline progress in both our CRM and client CRMs.
  • Track activity, outcomes, and ensure reporting is up to date.

Metrics & KPIs

  • Number of dials per day (150+ average) and meeting conversion rate.
  • Number of meaningful conversations and meetings booked.
  • Email outreach volume and reply rate.
  • Meeting attendance rate.

Schedule

  • Full-time, 40 hours/week.
  • Working hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM ET.
  • Open to applicants based in LATAM.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary + commission (60/40 split).
  • SPIFFs and performance incentives.
  • Training, mentoring, and growth opportunities to become a top-performing sales professional.


P.S. If you cold call me at -eight-eight on WhatsApp or reach out on LinkedIn, you’ll jump to the front of the line.

title: Médico Nefrologista em Telemedicina (com RQE)
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO NEFROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Nefrologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Nefrologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.


*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Nefrologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.



REQUISITOS

title: Project Accountant
description:
Project Financial Controller (Project Accountant)

Fixed-Term Contract – 18 Months

Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil (Initially remote, transitioning to project office)

Language Requirements: Bilingual English & Portuguese


Job Summary

Our client, a leading International Sports Marketing Firm, is supporting multiple high-profile projects connected to the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 . They are seeking an experienced Project Financial Controller / Project Accountant to play a critical role in the financial delivery of these projects.


This role partners closely with Project leadership to ensure robust financial control, accurate budgeting, profitability analysis, and full compliance with local legal and tax requirements. You will provide both commercial and operational finance support while coordinating with international finance teams and local professional advisors.


Key Responsibilities

Project Financial Management

  • Maintain and control client budgets, including detailed reporting and variance analysis
  • Monitor project financial performance and profitability across individual project elements
  • Track and report budget status for internal management and group reporting
  • Produce sensitivity and scenario analysis as required by senior leadership

Commercial & Operational Support

  • Provide ongoing commercial finance support to Project Managers and Project Directors
  • Interpret and apply commercial terms within client and supplier contracts
  • Oversee client invoicing processes and manage cash collection

Cash & Working Capital Management

  • Maintain strict cash controls and oversight of working capital
  • Prepare and manage weekly project cashflow forecasts for group submission
  • Act as a key liaison with local banking providers

Compliance & Governance

  • Ensure adherence to group financial controls, processes, and policies
  • Manage and ensure compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, including withholding and import duties
  • Work closely with local professional advisors to address legal, tax, and regulatory requirements

Shared Services & Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Liaise with international shared service centres to ensure efficient financial operations
  • Support cost coding, allocation, approvals, and financial data accuracy
  • Assist with supplier onboarding in coordination with shared service teams

Payroll & HR Support

  • Support preparation and execution of local payroll
  • Collaborate with HR and professional advisors on monthly payroll processes


Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Fully qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA, or equivalent)
  • Fluent in both English and Portuguese (written and spoken)
  • Proven experience in project accounting or working within project-led environments
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to interpret and manage contract terms
  • Solid knowledge of Brazilian laws, tax rules, and business practices
  • Experience operating in a multi-currency environment
  • Advanced Excel skills and strong analytical capability
  • Experience with Workday is desirable


Key Competencies

  • Highly analytical with strong attention to detail
  • Confident communicator able to engage effectively with senior project leaders
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and solutions-focused mindset
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, international project environment
  • Open to feedback with a continuous improvement mindset

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

O que você precisa ter:
