title: Senior Data Analyst (Web Analytics)
description:
Senior Data Analyst (Web Analytics)

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.


Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?


Qual será o seu papel?

Você será o principal responsável por transformar dados de comportamento digital em inteligência estratégica para o negócio. Atuará como referência técnica em mensuração e análise de performance web, garantindo que as decisões de produto, marketing e experiência do usuário sejam guiadas por dados confiáveis e bem interpretados. Seu trabalho conecta diretamente o que acontece nas propriedades digitais com os resultados que a empresa busca atingir.



Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Desenvolver e manter dashboards e relatórios de performance digital, acompanhando métricas como tráfego, conversão, engajamento e funis de aquisição
  • Implementar e auditar tags de rastreamento via Google Tag Manager, garantindo a integridade da coleta de dados nas propriedades digitais
  • Realizar análises exploratórias e apresentar insights para times de produto, marketing e liderança, traduzindo dados complexos em recomendações utilizáveis
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com os times de produto e UX para definir eventos de rastreamento, apoiar testes A/B e interpretar resultados de experimentos
  • Colaborar com times de engenharia e BI para estruturar pipelines de dados e garantir a disponibilidade das informações nas ferramentas certas
  • Disseminar a cultura de dados dentro da organização, apoiando outras áreas na utilização e interpretação de métricas digitais



Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Sólida experiência com Google Analytics 4 (GA4) e Google Tag Manager (GTM)
  • Conhecimento em configuração, implantação e estruturação de dataLayer via código (Javascript) ou Google Tag Manager (GTM)
  • Domínio de SQL para extração e análise de dados em ambientes de Data Warehouse (BigQuery, Amazon Redshift ou similar)
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização como Looker Studio, Quicksight, Power BI ou Tableau
  • Capacidade de comunicar análises e recomendações de forma clara para públicos não técnicos
  • Conhecimento em conceitos de mensuração digital: eventos, dimensões, métricas, atribuição e modelos de funil
  • Perfil analítico com autonomia para conduzir projetos de ponta a ponta com poucos direcionamentos
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Gestão de Projetos como JIRA e Confluence
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis como Scrum ou Kanban
  • Capacidade de gerir e disseminar conhecimento técnico com analistas de menor senioridade.



Você pode se destacar se tiver:

  • Experiência com Python ou R para análises mais avançadas (segmentação, modelos preditivos, análise estatística)
  • Conhecer ferramentas de análise de comportamento como Hotjar, Clarity ou similares
  • Vivência com plataformas de CRM Analytics ou dados de mídia paga integrados ao contexto de web analytics (Insider One, Salesforce)
  • Processos de implementação ou migração de ferramentas de analytics (ex: UA → GA4)
  • Migração de dados entre Data Warehouses (Big Query → AWS)
  • Conceitos de privacidade de dados e suas implicações na coleta (LGPD, consentimento, server-side tracking)
  • Plataformas de cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure)



Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Revel Street LLC helps corporate event planners discover and reach private dining venues through an extensive, dependable database. We use LLMs extensively to gather and enrich venue data, streamline the event planning workflow, and reduce the time and effort required to source options for events such as private dining, cocktail receptions, and conferences. We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer to help us improve data quality, fix existing data issues, and ingest more data from APIs and LLM-based sources to complement our current datasets. Our current stack includes React, TanStack, Cloudflare, Django, and Dagster, and we expect you to design solutions that are scalable, testable, and grounded in core engineering fundamentals.

Responsibilities

You’ll proactively turn ambiguous requirements into well-structured engineering plans. You’ll communicate trade-offs and risks early, and you’ll verify outcomes through hands-on testing. You’ll bring a “build, measure, improve” mindset to performance, reliability, and user experience.

  • Design, build, and maintain dbt pipelines for our analytics and operational workloads
  • Build and maintain ETL/ELT processes to ingest data from multiple APIs and other external sources
  • Set up and manage workflows in orchestration platforms such as Dagster
  • Develop and refine our data models to support analytics, reporting, and downstream products
  • Diagnose and fix data quality issues (duplicates, missing fields, inconsistent formats, incorrect mappings, etc.)
  • Implement robust data cleaning and validation checks
  • Integrate LLM-based data enrichment (e.g., using OpenAI or similar APIs) to improve and complement event data
  • Collaborate with our product and ops team to understand data needs and translate them into technical solutions

Requirements

  • Very high English proficiency (clear communication, strong writing, and the ability to collaborate effectively)
  • At least 3 years of data engineering experience including experience with dbt and the modern data stack
  • Some experience with devops, CI/CD, and database management.
  • At least 6 months of experience working exclusively in an agentic coding environment (e.g., Claude Code, Codex)
  • Ability to understand data engineering fundamentals, not just generate code—debugging, reasoning about behavior, and ensuring correctness
  • Some technical college degree

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
My client, a US Software Company, with offices in Brazil, is seeking seeks a motivated individual to join their Cloud Services team as a Cloud Engineer. This role supports and maintains their cloud environments and DevOps processes in a mixed cloud environment while collaborating with senior engineers on infrastructure improvements and architecture decisions. The position involves implementing and maintaining cloud-based solutions using Terraform Infrastructure as Code (IaC).


Primary Job Duties:

  • Work in an issue and project tracking system to document task details and track time.
  • Support and maintain the current cloud environment, infrastructure resources, applications, and project work.
  • Monitor cloud environment health and performance, troubleshoot and resolve issues.
  • Troubleshoot complex cloud infrastructure issues with minimal supervision.
  • Design and maintain scalable Terraform infrastructure, including reusable modules and structured patterns for multi-environment or multi-account deployments, with strong practices for state management and version-controlled workflows
  • Collaborate with senior engineers on cloud architecture and design.
  • Maintain environment security using industry best practices and established policies and procedures.
  • Support DevOps practices by working with development teams and stakeholders to maintain cloud resources and troubleshoot deployment issues.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, and operational runbooks.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of our products, technology, and practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve infrastructure automation, monitoring, deployment workflows, and cost savings.
  • Participate in incident reviews and root cause analysis.
  • Improve system reliability through automation and observability.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications: The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are required for the Cloud Engineer II role.

  • Minimum 2 years of experience with systems, infrastructure, or network administration.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience operating infrastructure in AWS.
  • Experience with infrastructure fundamentals including backup and recovery, disaster recovery, networking, and DNS.
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows.
  • Proficiency with monitoring, logging, and event analysis tools.
  • Proficiency with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices in a version-controlled environment (e.g., Git).
  • Proficiency in a common scripting language such as Python, bash, Perl, Ruby, or similar.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to self-prioritize multiple tasks and execute accordingly.
  • Able to work flexible hours outside normal business hours as required.
  • Strong written communication skills for email, documentation, and knowledge sharing.


Desired Qualifications: The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are highly desirable for the Cloud Engineer II role.

  • Associate degree (AA/AS) in a technical field or equivalent professional experience.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar) for improving engineering productivity.
  • AWS certification(s) such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, SysOps Administrator, or Developer.
  • Experience administering Linux and/or Windows operating systems.
  • Experience managing Active Directory or similar identity and directory services.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to learn and implement new technologies quickly.
  • Desire to gain knowledge and grow in the position.


This role starts at R$10,000 per month

PORQUÊ JUNTAR-SE À BAT?

Somos uma das poucas empresas nomeadas como Global Top Employer pelo Top Employers Institute - certificada em oferecer excelentes condições aos colaboradores.

A colaboração, a inclusão e a parceria estão na base de tudo o que fazemos na BAT. title: Data Annotator - Portuguese
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


About the Role


Job Title: Data Annotator

Employment Type: Freelance / Project-Based

Location: Remote (Work From Home)

Work Hours: Flexible; minimum commitment of 4–5 hours per day

Eligibility: Open to candidates with a Bachelor’s degree



We are seeking Data Annotator to support a data annotation and linguistic quality project aimed at training Large Language Models (LLMs) . This is a freelance, remote opportunity that offers flexible working hours.

The role involves understanding cultural and linguistic nuances, reviewing and annotating data, and following detailed project-specific guidelines to enhance AI performance and accuracy.


Key Responsibilities


  • Perform data annotation, and text evaluation in accordance with project-specific guidelines.
  • Ensure high-quality, accurate, and contextually relevant annotations to support Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Review, validate, and refine AI-generated content for grammatical, semantic, and contextual accuracy.
  • Maintain consistency and quality across all deliverables while adhering to established project standards and timelines.
  • Collaborate effectively with the project team to provide feedback and contribute to continuous improvement.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality and comply with all project deadlines and quality assurance protocols.


Required Skills & Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in mandatory.
  • Native proficiency in German language and the English language
  • Prior experience in data annotation , linguistic evaluation , or AI training projects.


What Makes This Role Exciting


  • Fully remote opportunity , allowing you to work comfortably from home.
  • Flexible working hours (4–5 hours per day) to suit your schedule.
  • The chance to contribute to cutting-edge AI and Large Language Model (LLM) training initiatives , shaping the future of language technology.


Note:

For this role, you are required to complete the English assessment within two (2) days from the date it is assigned to you.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Talent Acquisition Specialist


About Us:

We are a dynamic global specialist in talent research, intelligence, and pipelining. Since its founding in 2011, it’s grown to serve internal talent acquisition teams—including more than 70 Fortune 500 companies —through offices spanning the UK, US, India, Singapore, Dubai, Hong Kong, and beyond. We blend data-driven insight and proactive sourcing to streamline recruitment, delivering seamless access to ready now candidates and curated pipelines for future roles. Its recent acquisition of Armstrong Craven further strengthens our global reach and research capabilities, offering clients unmatched flexibility and depth in talent solutions


The Role:

We have partnered with a global FMCG powerhouse which has a reputation for innovation and development. As part of this contract we are looking for a passionate Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist. If you’re excited by new challenges, solving complex problems, and learning every step of the way, you might be the perfect fit. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to drive impactful projects and collaborate with bright minds.


What You’ll Do:

  • Manage autonomously the different talent acquisition solutions to source, engage, attract, and secure the right talent for the organization within a highly scientific environment
  • Partner with hiring managers to understand hiring needs, execute effective sourcing, engagement, screening, and behavioural-based interviews that deliver a diverse range of candidates and provide an outstanding candidate experience
  • Possess strong ability to screen, assess, interview, and build relationships within different talent communities in a timely and professional manner
  • Build and maintain market intelligence and a network of talent and potential candidates through previous experience, pro-active research, and ongoing relationships; conduct in-depth interviews of potential candidates, demonstrating ability to anticipate manager requirements through high interview-to-offer ratios
  • Display confidence to work with metrics and reporting to establish recruitment updates and insight to ensure hiring is effective and can clearly demonstrate successes versus areas of focus
  • Generate and recommend ideas and strategies related to recruitment that will contribute to the enhancement of hiring processes, implementing changes and new procedures, and fine-tuning standard recruiting processes that fit within the client’s mission
  • Contribute to or lead projects designed to implement change initiatives and enhance delivery
  • Articulate in writing a plan with deliverables, timelines, formal tracking, and reporting results
  • Promote continuous improvement of talent acquisition methods and processes


What we are looking for:

  • Passion for talent acquisition with an extensive track record of recruiting hard to fill roles
  • Expert understanding of talent networks and recruitment landscapes in Brazil and South America
  • Ability to execute sourcing activities, including but not limited to employer brand promotion, talent engagement and attraction, supporting events and meet-ups, and quality candidate pipeline generation with a significant proportion of direct and passive sourcing


Who You Are:

  • Someone who is not satisfied with “just good enough” and is always looking to improve, adapt, and innovate
  • A natural collaborator who loves sharing ideas and learning from others
  • Excellent communicator, both verbally and in writing, able to share complex ideas in a simple, relatable way
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese


Are You Still Curious?

If you’ve read this far, then chances are you’ve got a curious mind—just like us. So, what are you waiting for? Take the leap and apply today. We can’t wait to see where your curiosity leads you—and how it will shape the future of the client.

title: 3D Product Rendering Artist (Freelance)
description:
Are you looking to work for an innovative and exciting company from Silicon Valley or New York, 100% remotely?

We are looking for multi-skilled candidates with excellent creative and execution skills for the position of Product Render Expert (Freelance).

We are seeking highly talented Render Experts who can create high-quality, visually compelling product renders and animations for eCommerce, landing pages, and paid media. The ideal candidate has a strong eye for design, motion, lighting, and storytelling, and is able to take minimal direction and turn it into premium, production-ready visuals.


This role is project-based, with opportunities to collaborate in ongoing creative sprints. Candidates should be comfortable working independently and delivering high-quality work under limited guidance.

The compensation range is $5 to $20 USD per hour , depending on the candidate’s experience and quality of work.


Candidates from Latin America are highly encouraged to apply.

Candidates in a time zone outside of the western hemisphere will NOT be considered.

The role is 100% remote.

ALL RESUMES MUST BE SUBMITTED IN ENGLISH


Responsibilities:

  • Create high-quality product renders and short animations for web, social media, and paid advertising
  • Produce clean, modern, and premium visuals with strong attention to detail
  • Work with minimal direction to develop creative concepts and visual storytelling
  • Execute lighting, materials, and composition that enhance product appeal
  • Develop looping animations (5–10 seconds) suitable for digital platforms
  • Adapt renders across different backgrounds and formats
  • Collaborate in short creative sprints (audit + initial concepts + execution)
  • Continuously iterate and improve assets based on feedback


Requirements:

  • Proven experience creating high-quality product renders (portfolio required)
  • Strong skills in 3D rendering, lighting, materials, and composition
  • Experience with animation and motion design (looping animations preferred)
  • Ability to create realistic and visually appealing product imagery
  • Strong sense of modern design, aesthetics, and visual storytelling
  • Ability to work independently with limited direction
  • Experience working on eCommerce, branding, or paid media content
  • Detail-oriented with a strong focus on execution quality
  • Comfortable working on short, fast-paced projects (sprint-based work)


Assessment (Required):

As part of the process, candidates will complete a short render challenge designed to evaluate:

  • Product realism and material quality
  • Motion and animation quality
  • Creative thinking and execution
  • Attention to detail and overall design taste

This assignment is intended to be brief (~2 hours) and focuses on showcasing your approach and skills.


English Requirement:

Fluent in English — YOU MUST BE ABLE TO HAVE A FLUENT PROFESSIONAL CONVERSATION IN ENGLISH

title: Data Annotator
description:
Who is Blueprint Technologies?

We are a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with a strong presence across the United States and an expanding footprint across Latin America (LATAM). Our teams are united by a shared passion for solving complex problems.


At Blueprint, we use technology as a bridge between strategy and execution. Our people bring diverse perspectives, deep expertise, and real-world experience across industries to help organizations grow, transform, and innovate.


About the Role

We are seeking detail-oriented Labelers / Annotators to evaluate responses generated by AI systems across multiple languages .


This role focuses on side-by-side (SBS) evaluation of outputs from different AI models across real-world scenarios. You will play a key role in improving how AI systems understand and communicate across languages and cultures.


This is not a translation role . It is an evaluation and analysis role requiring strong judgment and attention to detail.


Language Requirement

Fluency in English + at least one of the following languages:

  • Chinese (Simplified and/or Traditional)
  • Japanese
  • Korean
  • Italian
  • German
  • French


What You’ll Work On

You will evaluate AI responses across scenarios such as:

  • General-purpose Q&A
  • Web search results
  • File-based and image-based responses
  • Image and file generation tasks
  • Single-turn and multi-turn conversations


Responsibilities

  • Perform side-by-side (SBS) comparisons of AI-generated responses
  • Evaluate outputs based on:
  • Accuracy
  • Relevance
  • Clarity
  • Instruction-following
  • Identify nuances in tone, meaning, and cultural context across languages
  • Apply detailed, scenario-specific annotation guidelines
  • Maintain consistency and high-quality evaluations


Required Qualifications

  • Professional fluency in English + at least one target language listed above
  • Prior experience with side-by-side (SBS) labeling or annotation
  • Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail
  • Ability to quickly understand and apply structured evaluation frameworks


Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in linguistics, translation, or localization
  • Experience in:
  • AI evaluation
  • Data annotation
  • Search relevance or content quality analysis


Compensation

We offer competitive compensation aligned with local markets and experience.

Estimated hourly range: R$75 – R$85 BRL

Estimated monthly equivalent (full-time): R$12,000 – R$13,600 BRL

Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity.


Training & Qualification

All new hires will complete a structured onboarding program, including:

  • Training sessions and practice exercises
  • Calibration against quality benchmarks
  • Qualification review before moving into production work


Benefits & Employment Structure

This role is hired through an Employer of Record (EOR) partner, ensuring full compliance with local labor laws and payroll requirements.

Employees receive locally compliant benefits, which may include:

  • Statutory benefits (e.g., paid leave, 13th salary where applicable)
  • Social security and healthcare contributions
  • Additional benefits aligned with local market practices


Why Blueprint?

  • Work on cutting-edge AI systems
  • Be part of a global, multilingual team
  • Build highly transferable AI evaluation skills
  • Contribute directly to improving real-world AI experiences


Equal Opportunity Employer

Blueprint Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, or any other protected status.

title: PMO #1003033
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


O que você precisa ter?

Procuramos por PMO para gerenciar e liderar o roadmap de desenvolvimento de soluções tecnológicas que suportarão projetos de dados, garantindo a orquestração entre squads, stakeholders e áreas de negócio, com foco em governança, arquitetura, engenharia e produtos de dados. É esperado que você combine a disciplina da gestão clássica de projetos com práticas ágeis modernas, dominando ferramentas e metodologias de ponta.


Requisitos:

  • Roadmap integrado com priorizações, desdobramentos e marcos.
  • Plano de comunicação e gestão de stakeholders (matriz RACI, mapeamento de impacto).
  • Métricas de sucesso do projeto e controle de entregas por squad ou frente.
  • Cronograma de capacitação e readiness (documentação, UAT, suporte de pós-go live).
  • Acompanhamento estruturado por metodologia híbrida (ágil + tradicional).
  • Planejamento e execução de Sprint 0 e fases Discovery, se aplicável.
  • Liderança: Capacidade de coordenar múltiplos times e níveis organizacionais com clareza, empatia e foco em resultado.
  • Comunicação executiva: Consegue transitar bem entre áreas técnicas e de negócio, ajustando linguagem e reportes.
  • Visão de produto e entrega: Compreende o ciclo completo de soluções de dados – da engenharia à aplicação no negócio.
  • Autonomia e ownership: Alta capacidade de autogestão, priorização e tomada de decisão em ambientes ambíguos.
  • Conhecimentos desejáveis
  • Governança de dados (DAMA, LGPD, catálogos, data quality, linhagem).
  • Ferramentas de visualização: Power BI, Looker, Tableau, Metabase.
  • Ferramentas de gestão de projetos: Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, MS Project.
  • Metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) e tradicionais (PMBOK, PRINCE2).
  • Conhecimento em produtos de dados, data mesh e arquiteturas modernas (data lake, cloud, event-driven).
  • Storytelling com dados: saber transformar indicadores e métricas em narrativas acionáveis.
  • Inglês fluente (Necessário para comunicação).


O que você fará no seu dia a dia?

  • Atuar como liderança técnica e referência na visão de cliente e negócio, fortalecendo o relacionamento com stakeholders internos e apoiando o desenvolvimento do time.
  • Ter forte orientação a negócio, compreendendo operações, métricas e processos para apoiar a tomada de decisão e o atingimento de metas.
  • Disseminar conhecimento por meio de documentação clara e comunicação efetiva entre pares e áreas.
  • Demonstrar atitude de dono, aplicando boas práticas em processos, tecnologias e entregas, com foco em resultados.
  • Atuar como interface entre áreas de negócio e tecnologia, conduzindo escopos de curto, médio e longo prazo com comunicação clara e assertiva.
  • Gerenciar projetos e programas de dados com múltiplas squads e alto nível de complexidade técnica e funcional.
  • Planejar e acompanhar roadmaps, cronogramas e marcos, garantindo previsibilidade das entregas.
  • Garantir business readiness, coordenando comunicação, treinamentos, documentação e alinhamentos necessários.
  • Facilitar rituais ágeis quando aplicável (Planning, Review, Retrospective).
  • Orquestrar dependências entre times de dados, produtos, arquitetura e governança.
  • Estabelecer rotinas de comunicação e reportes com stakeholders, acompanhando indicadores e progresso.
  • Organizar entregáveis finais como go-live, guias operacionais, planos de suporte e trilhas de capacitação.

title: AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
About FirstIgnite

FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.

We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.


The Role

We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.

This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.


What You'll Do

  • Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.
  • Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\"does this surface the right principal investigator?\") into precise, measurable rubrics.
  • Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.
  • Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.
  • Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.
  • Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.
  • Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling.
  • Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.
  • Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.
  • Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.
  • Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.
  • Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems.
  • Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain.
  • Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.


Why This Role

  • You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.
  • AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.
  • Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.
  • Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.


As part of your LinkedIn application submission, please use Loom to record a video and email it to us within the next 48 hours, along with your resume and Linkedin profile link. The recording should include both your camera (showing yourself) and your screen as you walk us through a project or piece of code you’re proud of.


Please email the video to with the title of the position you are applying for in the subject line. We look forward to your submission!

title: Interior Design Rendering Assistant (Remote)

$800–$1,000 USD/month + incentives

This is a unique opportunity to work directly with a designer who has more demand than they can handle and needs the right person to help translate their vision into high-quality renderings and design concepts.


The core of this role is simple: you will take floor plans, measurements, and direction from the designer and turn them into clean, accurate 2D layouts and realistic 3D renderings. This is not a general admin role. We’re specifically looking for someone who has experience with design software, a strong eye for aesthetics, and the ability to execute quickly and accurately. There is also a practical side to the role. You’ll assist with sourcing items, thinking through options at different price points, and having a basic understanding of how pricing, markups, and profitability factor into design decisions.


EVA will support you throughout the process, providing structure, training, and ongoing guidance while you work closely with the client. This is a long-term opportunity with room to grow into a larger role as the business scales.


If you have a background in interior design (or something similar), are comfortable with rendering tools, and have a strong attention to detail, this could be a great fit.

Nosso maior desafio é implementar, operar e monitorar a infraestrutura de forma escalável, com eficiência operacional e de custo, desenvolvendo automações para otimização do trabalho de SRE e provendo autonomia para os squads de engenharia.

title: UI/UX Designer (Salesforce)

Monthly salary: $1,800 - $2,200 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a UI/UX Designer with Salesforce Experience. You will be a champion of the end-user within their Salesforce projects. Your mission is to transform complex business processes into intuitive, high-fidelity digital experiences. You will apply user-centered design principles to the Salesforce platform, ensuring that solutions are not only functional but delightful to use. You will work closely with stakeholders to conduct user research and translate those insights into wireframes and prototypes that adhere to the Salesforce Lightning Design System (SLDS).


Must-have Technical Skills:

  • Proven Experience: 3+ years of professional UI/UX design experience with a strong portfolio showcasing user-centered design solutions.
  • Design Tools: Mastery of Figma (preferred), Sketch, or Adobe XD for creating high-fidelity mockups and interactive prototypes. Avonni is a plus.
  • Design Systems: Deep expertise in working with and extending design systems; specifically, a strong working knowledge of the Salesforce Lightning Design System (SLDS).
  • User Research: Experience conducting user interviews, surveys, and usability testing to validate design decisions.
  • Information Architecture: Ability to create site maps, user task flows, and wireframes that simplify complex Salesforce data structures.
  • Visual Design: Strong eye for typography, color theory, and layout, with a focus on creating accessible and responsive web interfaces.
  • Prototyping: Ability to build click-through prototypes to communicate interactions and transitions to stakeholders and developers.


Salesforce Specific Knowledge:

  • Platform Awareness: Understanding of Salesforce \"Out-of-the-Box\" layout capabilities and limitations (e.g., Lightning App Builder, Page Layouts, and Dynamic Forms).
  • Component-Based Design: Familiarity with how Salesforce components behave to ensure designs are technically feasible for developers to build.
  • Experience Cloud: Knowledge of the branding and styling capabilities within Salesforce Experience Builder.


Desirable Skills:

  • Accessibility: Knowledge of WCAG 2.1 compliance and how to apply accessibility standards within a Salesforce environment.
  • Workshop Facilitation: Experience leading Design Thinking workshops or discovery sessions with clients.


Interpersonal Skills:

  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to translate business goals into logical user journeys.
  • Collaboration: Experience working in an Agile environment alongside Business Analysts and Salesforce Developers.
  • Storytelling: Strong ability to present design concepts and \"sell\" the UX vision to non-technical stakeholders.


Certifications:

  • Salesforce Certified User Experience (UX) Designer (Highly Preferred)
  • Salesforce Certified Strategy Designer (Desirable)
  • Google UX Design Professional Certificate or similar industry accreditation.


Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, UI/UX Design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), or a related field.
  • Equivalent professional portfolio and work experience.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to design user-centered Salesforce experiences that transform complex business processes into intuitive and impactful solutions.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


Work Schedule: Full-time (160-hours/month) working core EST US time zone.


Project timeline: May 4th to December 31st, 2026


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Médico Oncologista Genético (com RQE)
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ONCOLOGISTA GENÉTICO NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Oncologia Genética! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Oncologia Genética, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.


*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Oncologista Genético de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios oncológicos.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças de ordem Oncologista Genética.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Oncologista Genética.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ONCOLOGIA.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Oncologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado);
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);



Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Oncologia sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.



Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.



Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO


Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Title: Data Scientist

Location: 100% Remote

Job Type: Contract


Mandatory Skills

• Mathematical Optimization

• Advanced Programming

• statistical modeling

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly analytical Data Scientist to serve as a technical cornerstone within our Supply Chain organization. This role sits at the intersection of Mathematical Optimization, Statistics, and Software Engineering, focusing on uncovering hidden insights and driving data-driven decision-making. You will be responsible for designing and deploying innovative prescriptive analytics solutions that optimize our global operations at strategic, tactical, and operational levels.

• Advanced Modeling : Develop and deploy complex mathematical programming models (MILP, NLP, etc.) to optimize long-term supply chain and manufacturing processes.

• End-to-End Analytics : Perform statistical analysis on diverse healthcare datasets (structured and unstructured) to extract actionable business intelligence.

• Algorithmic Development : Design and implement custom computational solutions using high-performance languages like Julia, Python, or Mosel.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with stakeholders across the organization to translate ambiguous business problems into rigorous technical requirements and scalable solutions.

• Tool Integration : Leverage industry-leading solvers (Gurobi, CPLEX, BARON) to solve large-scale resource allocation, scheduling, and inventory challenges.

Required Qualifications

• M.Sc. or Ph.D. in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.

• Proven experience in mathematical programming and algorithm development for process optimization.

• Advanced coding skills in Python, Julia, or R , with hands-on experience using optimization solvers.

• Solid understanding of supply chain fundamentals (planning, inventory management, scheduling) and manufacturing business processes.

Working knowledge of machine learning (regression, clustering, neural networks) and experience handling large-scale datasets.

Thanks

Aatmesh

title: Webflow Web Designer
description:

Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $1,500 USD


About Tecla

Tecla is recruitment and talent infrastructure for AI-forward companies. We place AI leaders, engineers, and specialists across the United States and Latin America, serving the technology teams at companies of every shape and size, from venture-backed startups to global enterprises. We have been recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies, hold a 4.8/5 rating on Trustpilot, and have served 500+ companies.


This role sits on our internal Growth team, working on our website (tecla.io). You will build and update landing pages, ship campaign assets, and improve site performance as our brand and offering keep evolving.


About the role

We are hiring a Webflow Web Designer to work alongside our lead Webflow designer. This is a real design role. Tecla has its own Webflow design system, and you will use that system to design and ship landing pages, blog pages, and other site work. We are not handing you pixel-perfect mockups to copy. You are designing the page, applying our system with taste and judgment, and bringing UX and UI chops to every layout you ship.


This role is also built for someone who lives in AI tools. We want a designer whose workflow is fundamentally AI-powered, not someone who occasionally pastes a prompt into ChatGPT. The pace of change in our industry is fast, and we want a teammate who is using AI to learn faster, build faster, and continuously raise the bar on what one designer can ship in a week.


You will be coached. You will grow fast. The ceiling is high if you bring real hunger, energy, and curiosity.


What you will do

  • Design and build landing pages, blog templates, and web assets in Webflow, working from our design system
  • Translate outlines from the content and performance teams into polished, high-performing pages
  • Improve site speed, responsiveness, and SEO hygiene across the site
  • Use AI tools across your workflow to move faster: prototyping, copy iteration, code, debugging, asset generation, QA, optimization
  • Collaborate closely with our lead Webflow designer, brand and creative, and the rest of the Growth team
  • Keep visual and UX consistency across the site
  • Stay on top of new tools and techniques and bring the best ones into how we work


What we are looking for

  • 1 to 2 years of hands-on Webflow experience. You can build pages from scratch, not just edit existing ones
  • Real UX and UI design skills. You can design a page, not just execute a mockup. You will be designing landing pages and blog pages using our existing design system, applying taste and judgment along the way
  • A real, demonstrable AI-powered workflow. You use AI tools daily and have opinions about which ones are worth the time. We will ask for specifics in the interview
  • Solid fundamentals in HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript
  • Fast, energetic, and naturally curious. You move quickly without being sloppy
  • Coachable. You take feedback well, apply it, and ask for more
  • Strong written and spoken English. You will be working closely with the team and with leadership


Nice to have

  • Experience applying SEO best practices on Webflow sites
  • Comfort with custom code in Webflow (embeds, interactions, CMS work)
  • Familiarity with Figma and modern design workflows
  • Background in marketing, growth, or agency environments


Why Tecla

  • Direct exposure to Tecla's leadership and the Growth team. Your work ships and gets seen
  • Real coaching and a clear path to grow, both in craft and in scope
  • A front-row seat to how we are building an AI-forward company across recruiting, growth, and operations
  • Fully remote, distributed across Latin America
  • Generous PTO plus local holidays in your country
  • A team that ships fast and takes the work seriously


*Please note we are only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.

title: Estágio de Direito - Home Office
description:
O escritório Ulisses Carneiro Advogados  ( especializado em Direito Previdenciário (RGPS) , com sede em Brasília e atuação em todo o território nacional, está com vaga aberta para Estágio em Direito  (6º ao 9º semestre), com atuação 100% home office .

Sobre o Escritório

Com mais de 17 anos de experiência  e 50 mil clientes atendidos em todo o Brasil , o escritório Ulisses Carneiro Advogados se consolidou como referência em Direito Previdenciário.

Somos também pioneiros no uso de tecnologia na advocacia: contamos com o ADV Space , nosso próprio software jurídico integrado com inteligência artificial, criado para otimizar atendimentos e transformar a experiência do cliente.

Nosso fundador, Bruno Ulisses Carneiro, começou a programar em 1998, aos 14 anos, e desde então une Direito e tecnologia para criar soluções inovadoras. Além de advogado, Bruno é professor do Instituto Professora Melissa Folmann , onde já formou centenas de advogados e mentorou profissionais que hoje lideram seus próprios escritórios.


Aqui, o estágio não é apenas cumprir horas: é uma oportunidade de aprender na prática  com quem já formou talentos e continua transformando a advocacia com inovação.

Detalhes da Vaga

  • Horário:  9h às 15h (6 horas diárias)
  • Bolsa:  R$ 1.200,00 + ajuda de custo para home office
  • Modelo:  100% remoto (aceitamos candidatos de qualquer localidade)
  • Início:  imediato, após formalização do contrato pelo IEL


✅ O que esperamos de você

  • Estar cursando entre o 6º e o 9º semestre de Direito .
  • Ter vivência prática em Direito Previdenciário  (estágio anterior, núcleo de prática ou projetos reais).
  • Boa comunicação escrita e/ou oral (recepção de clientes, análise de casos, auxílio em conversão de contratos).
  • Comprometimento, organização e vontade de crescer.

title: Consultor SAP SD OTC/PTP (AMS)
description:
Consultor SAP SD OTC/PTP (AMS) - 14116


Tempo de Alocação: Indeterminado

Local de Trabalho: 100% remoto

Horário de Trabalho: comercial

Contratação Pj ou Cooperativa


Conhecimentos e Competências Necessárias:

• Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência comprovada como consultor SAP SD/OTC e nível intermediário em MM/P2P, com atuação prática em configuração e suporte aos processos order-to-cash e procure-to-pay.

• Inglês avançado/fluente

• Forte conhecimento em SAP S/4HANA, incluindo integração entre os módulos SD, MM e FI. É necessário conhecimento em EDI.

• Experiência com SAP S/4HANA public cloud será considerada um diferencial.

• Capacidade de analisar processos de negócio complexos e projetar soluções SAP eficazes.

• Excelentes habilidades de resolução de problemas, comunicação e gestão de stakeholders.

• Experiência em treinamento de usuários e elaboração de documentação.

• Conhecimento dos processos de compras, execução logística e financeiros no SAP.

• Preferencialmente experiência com metodologia ITIL.

• Familiaridade com ferramentas ITSM (ServiceNow, ManageEngine ou similares) para gestão de chamados.

• Graduação em Tecnologia da Informação, Supply Chain, Administração ou áreas relacionadas.


Responsabilidades:

• Fornecer suporte funcional e técnico para os processos SAP (SD) e (MM), incluindo gestão de pedidos, entregas, faturamento, compras, processamento de faturas e pagamentos.

• Configurar e manter os módulos SAP SD (Sales & Distribution) e MM (Materials Management) para atender aos requisitos de negócio relacionados ao cumprimento de pedidos e à área de compras.

• Analisar necessidades do negócio e traduzi-las em soluções SAP, especialmente nas áreas de execução logística, compras e integração financeira.

• Apoiar o design, implementação e otimização das funcionalidades do SAP S/4HANA para os ciclos OTC e P2P.

• Colaborar com as áreas de negócio para levantamento de requisitos, condução de workshops e entrega de melhorias de processos.

• Identificar e resolver problemas relacionados ao processamento de pedidos, compras e pontos de integração entre os módulos SD, MM e FI. É necessário conhecimento em EDI.

• Desenvolver e manter documentação, incluindo especificações funcionais, guias de configuração e materiais de treinamento.

• Conduzir treinamentos para usuários e oferecer suporte contínuo para garantir o uso eficaz do sistema.

• Manter-se atualizado sobre inovações do SAP S/4HANA, especialmente nos módulos SD e MM, e recomendar melhores práticas para melhoria contínua.


Maiores detalhes serão fornecidos durante a entrevista técnica com o cliente.

Somos uma consultoria sólida no mercado de TI, com operações na América do Sul, América do Norte e Europa. Certificada pelo Great Place to Work®, somos reconhecidos por nossa forma única de valorizar profissionais e promover um ambiente diferenciado.

title: Engenheiro de dados Pleno #997215
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


O que você precisa ter?

• Experiência comprovada em ambientes de nuvem - Azure, AWS ou GCP;

• Domínio e aplicação de Arquiteturas Lakehouse;

• Conhecimento de ambientes de Data Lakes;

• Conhecimento em Arquitetura de Event-Driven (EDA)

• Conhecimento em Mensageria (Kafka, Eventhubs, SQS, ServiceBus ou PubSub)

• Conhecimento em plataformas de integração de dados (StreamSets ou Azure Data Factory);

• Conhecimento de tecnologias de processamento de dados (ex.: Spark, Scala, Databricks);

• Conhecimento sobre bases de dados relacionais (ex.: PostgreSQL) e não-relacionais (ex.: MongoDB);

• Capacidade de analisar e modelar bases de dados;

• Conhecer fluxos e ferramentas de CI/CD;

• Domínio da metodologia Ágil;

• Conhecimento em padrões de MicroServies.


Considerado diferencial:

• Ter instalado ferramentas de integração de dados (on premisses ou cloud);

• Atuado na administração de ferramentas (on premisses ou cloud);

• Capacidade para fazer troubleshooting em erros de conexão/conectividade;

• Entender requisitos arquiteturais técnicos e impactos desses nas soluções;

• Aplicação de TOGAF, DAMA ou frameworks de arquitetura similares;

• Ter atuado em iniciativas relacionadas a LGDP, GDPR e segurança da informação;

• Compreensão dos diferentes tipos de protocolo HTTP, AMQP, TCP, TLS;

• Conhecimento e utilização de ferramentas para APM, Observabilidade, Monitoria e Logging (ex.: NewRelic, Dynatrace, Datadog, ELK, etc.);

• Experiência no trabalho com Containers, em especial, Kubernetes.


Local de atuação: No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Cientista de Dados | Prevenção a Fraude (Foco em IA)
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados que una o rigor estatístico à agilidade das novas tecnologias de Inteligência Artificial. Aqui, você será a peça-chave para identificar padrões ocultos e construir sistemas de defesa inteligentes que garantam a segurança do nosso ecossistema de forma escalável e inovadora.


Como será o seu dia a dia

  • Modelagem e Antecipação: Desenvolver e implementar modelos de Machine Learning e algoritmos estatísticos para detectar, identificar e, principalmente, antecipar padrões de fraude.
  • IA no Estado da Arte: Utilizar ferramentas avançadas de IA e técnicas de análise de dados para otimizar a precisão das defesas e a escalabilidade dos processos.
  • Visão Estratégica: Transformar grandes volumes de dados em insights acionáveis, propondo soluções que equilibrem segurança e experiência do usuário.
  • Colaboração Ativa: Atuar em parceria com times de Produto, Engenharia e Negócios para garantir que os modelos estejam perfeitamente integrados à nossa plataforma.
  • Mentoria e Cultura: Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico de membros Júniores e Plenos, promovendo um ambiente de troca de conhecimento e inovação contínua.
  • MLOps e Ciclo de Vida do Modelo: Conhecimento em práticas de MLOps — Monitorar continuamente os modelos em produção, identificando degradações de performance, drift de dados e necessidade de re-treino.


O que buscamos (Requisitos Técnicos)

  • Base Estatística Sólida: Domínio de conceitos estatísticos aplicados à modelagem e análise de comportamento.
  • Domínio de Programação: Experiência avançada em Python e SQL (R é um diferencial).
  • Toolkit de IA: Experiência prática com frameworks de Machine Learning e abertura/entusiasmo para utilizar novas ferramentas de IA (GenAI, Auto ML, etc.) para otimização de fluxos.
  • Cloud e Big Data: Vivência em ambientes de nuvem (preferencialmente AWS ) e manipulação de grandes datasets.
  • Agilidade: Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis e capacidade de entrega em ciclos rápidos.
  • Formação: Graduação ou pós-graduação em Estatística, Matemática, Ciência da Computação ou áreas quantitativas.


Perfil Comportamental (O que nos brilha o olho)

  • Comunicação Excepcional: Capacidade de traduzir termos técnicos complexos para stakeholders de diferentes áreas e níveis de liderança.
  • Mentalidade Colaborativa (Team First): Valorizamos quem joga para o time. Buscamos profissionais que saibam pedir e oferecer ajuda, sem resistências ao trabalho em grupo.
  • Mindset de Inovação: Curiosidade para testar novas ferramentas e questionar o \"status quo\" dos processos de prevenção.
  • Resiliência e Flexibilidade: Capacidade de se adaptar a mudanças de cenário e novos padrões de fraude com agilidade.
  • Sensibilidade ao Falso Positivo: Consciência do impacto do falso positivo — saber que um bloqueio indevido tem custo real para o usuário legítimo e para o negócio.


Por que vir para cá?

  • Ambiente de comunicação aberta e horizontal.
  • Oportunidade de atuar com tecnologias de ponta em um problema real e de alto impacto.
  • Foco real em desenvolvimento contínuo e bem-estar do time.

title: Senior Backend Developer KYC (100% remote Worldwide)
description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.


Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.


Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?


About the job

As a senior Backend Developer, you will be a part of the team that works on the development and maintenance of the backend components of multiple services related to the platform. This includes:

  • New Products and Features - Tether continuously strives to create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional experience for customers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies, to ensure the user experience remains the best in the industry.
  • Scalability - all backend services that power Tether platform must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth.
  • Security - Tether makes Security its most important feature. The Backend Development team is responsible for building all the API services and backend processes with the highest security principles and standard, in order to protect the safety of the entire user base.


Responsibilities

  • Work closely with developers, product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to translate requirements into clear, practical architectures.
  • Improve existing core backend services written in NodeJS
  • Implement new solutions that interact with different core services through RPC calls
  • Write complex database queries for compliance and financial purposes


Requirements

  • At least 5 years of experience working with Javascript/Nodejs.
  • Familiar with microservices architecture
  • Have actively participated in the development of a complex platform
  • Good experience in interacting with databases (MySQL, MongoDB)
  • Ability to quickly learn new technologies
  • Good understanding of security practices


Preferred skills

  • Experience with blockchain integration
  • Comfortable with high-availability concepts
  • Ruby and Rails experience
  • Other technologies of interest: Message queues (Redis), Caches and Job Queues


Important information for candidates

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:
  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

title: Analista de Atendimento - Mercado de Investimentos
